name: blindrelay
description: Send transactional email and manage sending domains, OTLP observability, and suppression via Blindrelay — a zero-content EU email relay. Cursor-optimized entry: set BLINDRELAY_API_KEY once under Plugins → Configure; no manual header editing.

BLINDRELAY_API_KEY.title: Blindrelay API key
BLINDRELAY_API_KEY.description: Scoped API key from https://blindrelay.app/keys (one-time reveal). Scopes: send (Free), read/write (Starter+). Stored only in the Cursor dashboard, never in the plugin repo.

BLINDRELAY_MCP_URL.title: Blindrelay MCP endpoint URL
BLINDRELAY_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Defaults to the production endpoint https://api.blindrelay.app/mcp.
